display.title: Episode 384: Torah, the Best Thing of All, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi teaches the song 'Ad Mosai', a boy from Michigan recites the Shema, and chapter 1 of Rabbi Akiva's voyage with the boastful merchants begins.
display.summary_long: Broadcast at the start of the summer of 1989. Uncle Yossi opens with the new summer Tzivos Hashem newsletter and how to join Hashem's army, then tells children that they will be at the head of the parade to greet Moshiach, riding the heavenly clouds to Eretz Yisroel as the prophet Daniel foretold. He teaches the words of the song 'Ad Mosai' line by line, plays it on the keyboard, and turns it into the Hakochainik march. A visiting boy from Ann Arbor, Michigan, recites the Shema and tells how the Rebbe gave him a dollar for tzedakah. Story time begins 'Torah, the Best Thing of All': on a ship full of wealthy merchants boasting of gold, silver and diamonds, Rabbi Akiva says he carries a treasure worth more than all of them, which no one can take away. Mitzvah time continues the laws of Havdalah: why we smell besamim when the extra Shabbos soul departs, and how Shabbos can bring Moshiach.
display.lesson: The Torah you learn is a treasure that is yours forever; no one can ever take it away.
